connections.description: External connections, one values layer per projects/<project>/connections/<name>.yaml.

okdp-lib.description: Values slot Helm creates for the okdp-lib library dependency. Not a parameter.

cpu.title: CPU (vCPU)
cpu.description: Notebook (singleuser) pod CPU guarantee in vCPU. The limit is twice the guarantee.

memoryGi.title: Memory (GiB)
memoryGi.description: Notebook (singleuser) pod memory guarantee in GiB. The limit is twice the guarantee.

welcomeNotebook.title: Welcome notebook
welcomeNotebook.description: Welcome.ipynb content copied into each user home.

storage.title: Object store
storage.description: Connection to the S3-compatible object store backing the jupyter-fs file browser.

s3SecretRef.title: S3 credentials secret
s3SecretRef.description: Secret with keys accessKey/secretKey, this instance's own S3 identity.

fileBrowserLocations.title: File browser locations
fileBrowserLocations.description: jupyter-fs file browser locations (display name + s3 uri).

oidcRoleMapping.title: Role mapping
oidcRoleMapping.description: Optional GenericOAuthenticator overrides (claim_groups_key, allowed_groups, admin_groups, ...). Without allowed_groups the hub answers 403 to everyone.

pyspark.title: Enabled connections
pyspark.description: Names of the Spark connections below to wire into the PySpark kernel. Empty leaves the kernel without S3A or catalog settings.

sparkConnections.title: Connections
sparkConnections.description: PySpark connections: final spark conf lines (one per line) and optionally their own S3 identity (Secret with accessKey/secretKey, referenced as $(S3_ACCESS_KEY)/$(S3_SECRET_KEY)).

sparkDefaults.title: Conf defaults
sparkDefaults.description: Spark conf defaults injected into PYSPARK_SUBMIT_ARGS (final values).
